objective: Improve JavaScript, TypeScript, and CSS parser/formatter throughput across frozen deterministic large files. Preserve byte-exact formatted output, parser diagnostic hashes, idempotence, relevant parser/formatter regression tests, and peak RSS within 2% of baseline. Only the four pinned parser/formatter crate src trees are mutable.

meta.provenance: Pinned Biome 8ebafe1c7489f1f7af379b8e52b8ad063c82d28a. Workload operations reproduce the uncached parse and format-node/print paths of the upstream JS, TS, and CSS Criterion benches. Third-party CDN benchmark inputs were not redistributed; deterministic large JS/TS/CSS and recovery sources were generated and frozen instead. qReference is constructed after locked A-A calibration as qBase + max(5*sigma, 0.05*abs(qBase-qFail)).
meta.license: MIT OR Apache-2.0; upstream notices preserved in baseline/LICENSES and image; generated workloads are CC0-1.0

headroom.requirement: gate-7 development-train headroom: three two-episode seed-optimizer pilots on the current host must produce at least one valid non-baseline candidate while fewer than three runs reach qReference
headroom.pilotPath: trusted supervisor + local backend + broker measurement path under trusted synthetic-meta authority (admissionReview off); no optimizer-queryable state

sourceDetails.offlineDependencies: cargo vendor from the pinned Cargo.lock at toolchain/vendor; CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true; evaluator network disabled

measurement.platform: Docker Desktop Linux arm64 on Apple M3 Max; provisional local calibration
measurement.q: reciprocal geometric mean trusted-parent wall milliseconds per repetition across parse and format workloads; per workload the fastest k of N samples are trimmed-mean averaged to reject host-contention outliers; every sample is receipt-bound to the protected oracle
measurement.rssGate: peak workload RSS <= frozen ceiling rssLimitKb (33000 KiB); recalibrated for the trusted-parent wall-timing harness whose peak is dominated by the formatter IR plus glibc arena retention, giving ~1.11x the observed baseline peak (~29620 KiB) so legitimate perturbations clear allocator/measurement variance while gross memory blow-ups are still rejected
